changelog:
- Initial release of the content-memory skill.
- Enables AI agents to remember and recall content ideas and drafts using persistent vector memory powered by BlueColumn.
- Supports storing, searching, and recalling content memory via BlueColumn API endpoints.
- Requires a BlueColumn API key (bc_live_*).
- Includes workflow guidelines and example API calls for integration.
summary: Give AI agents Remember content ideas and drafts. using BlueColumn persistent memory. Use when an agent supports content creation and needs idea continuity; when the user wants to store, recall, or search content memory context. Requires a BlueColumn API key (bc_live_*).
